transcript: Hello, I am calling from State Bank. Your account has an urgent verification flag and will be blocked today. Please share the OTP sent to your phone immediately to verify.
This is Inspector Sharma from Crime Branch Delhi. A package with illegal drugs in your name was seized by customs. You are under digital arrest right now. Do not hang up.
Sir I am sending you a refund of 5000 rupees. Please scan this QR code and enter your secret UPI PIN to receive the money in your account.
Good morning. I need to update my KYC at the bank branch tomorrow morning when I visit with my Aadhaar document.
Hi, this is Blue Dart courier. I have a book parcel for Rahul. Are you available at your address to collect it?
Hey bro, thanks for dinner yesterday! My friend sent me money through UPI to split the bill, so I just transferred your share.
